# pink petals: one segment per click on the ground, facing opposite the player (south)
B 1 -61 2 minecraft:grass_block[snowy=false]
B 1 -60 2 minecraft:pink_petals[facing=north,flower_amount=1]
I Alice 0 minecraft:pink_petals*15
B 1 -61 2 minecraft:grass_block[snowy=false]
B 1 -60 2 minecraft:pink_petals[facing=north,flower_amount=2]
I Alice 0 minecraft:pink_petals*14
# clicking the petals themselves also adds a segment
B 1 -61 2 minecraft:grass_block[snowy=false]
B 1 -60 2 minecraft:pink_petals[facing=north,flower_amount=4]
I Alice 0 minecraft:pink_petals*12
# a fifth segment is refused, the stack is not consumed
B 1 -61 2 minecraft:grass_block[snowy=false]
B 1 -60 2 minecraft:pink_petals[facing=north,flower_amount=4]
I Alice 0 minecraft:pink_petals*12
# another facing: the player looks west

B 4 -61 2 minecraft:grass_block[snowy=false]
B 4 -60 2 minecraft:pink_petals[facing=west,flower_amount=1]
# pink petals on a block that cannot support it
B 5 -61 2 minecraft:stone
I Alice 0 minecraft:pink_petals*8
# wildflowers

B 1 -60 3 minecraft:wildflowers[facing=north,flower_amount=3]
I Alice 0 minecraft:wildflowers*5
# another item on petals: wildflowers onto pink petals, stone onto wildflowers

B 1 -61 3 minecraft:grass_block[snowy=false]
B 1 -60 2 minecraft:pink_petals[facing=north,flower_amount=4]
B 1 -60 3 minecraft:wildflowers[facing=north,flower_amount=3]
I Alice 0 minecraft:wildflowers*5
B 1 -61 2 minecraft:grass_block[snowy=false]
B 1 -61 3 minecraft:grass_block[snowy=false]
B 1 -61 4 minecraft:grass_block[snowy=false]
B 1 -60 2 minecraft:pink_petals[facing=north,flower_amount=4]
B 1 -60 3 minecraft:wildflowers[facing=north,flower_amount=3]
B 1 -59 3 minecraft:stone
I Alice 0 minecraft:stone*7

# leaf litter on glass, on a bottom slab (top face not sturdy) and on a top slab
B 2 -61 4 minecraft:glass
B 2 -60 4 minecraft:leaf_litter[facing=north,segment_amount=1]
B 3 -61 4 minecraft:oak_slab[type=bottom,waterlogged=false]
B 4 -61 4 minecraft:oak_slab[type=top,waterlogged=false]
B 4 -60 4 minecraft:leaf_litter[facing=north,segment_amount=1]
I Alice 0 minecraft:leaf_litter*2

# sneaking: the first click places a segment on empty ground, further clicks add none (isSecondaryUseActive); without sneaking the segment is added
B 11 -61 2 minecraft:grass_block[snowy=false]
B 11 -60 2 minecraft:pink_petals[facing=north,flower_amount=1]
I Sneaky 0 minecraft:pink_petals*7
B 11 -61 2 minecraft:grass_block[snowy=false]
B 11 -60 2 minecraft:pink_petals[facing=north,flower_amount=2]
I Sneaky 0 minecraft:pink_petals*6
